items.author: WolfRiccardo
items.text: I’m continuing my tests of the new GPT-Image model currently circulating on @arena. First, take a look at the prompt below. A few things I’ve noticed so far: **The new model (mona-lisa-1) seems to analyze and understand prompts much better, especially when the scene gets complicated. For example, the prompt specifically asks for two different couples — four people total — arguing with each other. mona-lisa-1 got this right immediately, while, interestingly, the current GPT-Image model failed to follow it correctly. **GPT-Image-2 still has that dark, overly contrasty and plastic-looking output. I don’t even remember it looking this bad when it was first released. In my opinion, the model has been significantly weakened over time. **mona-lisa-1 shows some really nice improvements in human appearance, anatomy, and overall realism. People look noticeably more natural, and the model seems much better at handling complex scenes without everything turning into a mess. If there’s anything specific you want me to test, drop it below. I’ll try it and share the comparisons. ____________________________________________ PROMPT: RAW iPhone photo quality, completely unedited smartphone-camera look, natural exposure, realistic lighting. COMPOSITION: On the FAR LEFT side of the frame, a man wearing a formal business suit has fallen onto the ground. An elderly woman wearing a green shirt is bending down and trying to help him stand up. In the FAR BACKGROUND, directly across the scene, a black cat is clearly visible sitting by a window and staring outside. In the FRONT-MIDDLE area, TWO DIFFERENT COUPLES — four adults total — are having a heated argument with each other, using natural hand gestures and expressive body language. On the FAR RIGHT side, THREE PEOPLE are dancing together. Their shirts clearly display the OpenAI logo. Each person wears a hat with a large readable number: 23, 44, 98 High above the scene, an airplane is flying across the sky while towing a large banner behind it. The banner clearly reads: “@WolfRiccardo — NEW GPT-IMAGE MODEL COMING SOON!” At the VERY FRONT of the frame, closest to the camera, Will Smith is accidentally tripping over a plate/pile of spaghetti on the ground and falling forward in a spontaneous, comedic moment. Everything must appear inside the SAME photograph at the SAME time. Make every character, action, object, number, logo and text clearly distinguishable and spatially separated.
